literal_meaning: দ্রুত বা চটপটে শব্দ বা কাজের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic reduplication suggesting quick, snappy actions or sounds)
example_sentences_in_english: They are bickering all day long.
A quarrel has started between the neighbors.
note: This idiom captures the everyday verbal sparring common in Bengali social dynamics, often used to describe minor but persistent conflicts.
